manifesto.paragraph1: We are Vr0cks. We believe there's no room for mediocrity in the digital world. For your brand, we don't just create a website—we build a living, breathing prestige.
manifesto.paragraph2: We sculpt complex code into elegant, functional works of art with a "Less is more" philosophy. Speed, aesthetics, and perfection are our standards.
manifesto.paragraph3: We obsess over the details so you can simply enjoy the results.

faq.title: Frequently Asked.
faq.subtitle: We've compiled the answers to your questions in the simplest form.

items.question: How does the process work, when do I get delivery?
items.answer: We don't tire you with complicated processes. First we discuss your goals, then we prepare a custom design for your approval. After approval, we complete the coding and launch your site within an average of 2-4 weeks.

items.question: Will my site rank high on Google?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our sites don't just look stylish; they're coded with Google's favorite infrastructure (SEO-friendly, ultra-fast, and mobile-friendly). This puts you 1-0 ahead of your competitors.

items.question: Can I update the site myself later?
items.answer: Yes. If you wish, we integrate a very easy-to-use management panel to your site. You can update your texts, images, or products like sharing an Instagram post without any coding knowledge.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Every business has different needs. Instead of template sites, we make a 'digital suit' tailored just for you. We offer the fairest and most transparent quote based on the project scope.

items.question: Do you provide support after the site is finished?
items.answer: Working with us isn't a one-time job, it's a long-term partnership. We're always by your side for technical support, maintenance, and updates even after the site goes live.
